# Rivera Fragrance House

> 100% Authentic Middle Eastern and Designer Fragrances at Honest Direct Prices in the Philippines.

Rivera Fragrance House is a trusted, family-run fragrance business based in Malabon, Metro Manila, Philippines. We specialize in importing original factory-sealed perfumes directly from authorized distributors in Dubai and the UAE, bypassing inflated mall markups to provide fair retail rates and wholesale bulk pricing for resellers and fragrance enthusiasts nationwide.

## Core Offerings

- **Original Middle Eastern Fragrances**: Popular beast-mode performers from Rasasi, Armaf, Fragrance World, Rayhaan, Afnan, Lattafa, Maison Alhambra, French Avenue, Khadlaj, Zimaya, and Riiffs.
- **Factory-Sealed Bottles**: Every unit arrives in its original factory packaging with verifiable batch codes. We maintain a strict zero-counterfeit policy.
- **Wholesale & Personal Retail**: Single bottle purchases for daily personal wear or discounted multi-bottle cartons for local perfume resellers across the Philippines.
- **Nationwide Delivery**: Rapid courier dispatch across Metro Manila and provincial delivery to Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao with heavy-duty protective packaging.
- **Currency & Pricing**: All prices are transparently displayed in Philippine Pesos (PHP, ₱).

## Key Website Links

- [Live Fragrance Catalog & Current Stock](https://riverafragrances.com/catalog): Real-time inventory of in-stock perfumes with retail prices, fragrance DNA notes, and flash sale discounts.
- [Curated Collections](https://riverafragrances.com/collections): Browse fragrances by scent profile, season (warm Philippine climate, evening, fresh everyday), and brand house.
- [About Rivera Fragrance House](https://riverafragrances.com/about): Our family story, authenticity guarantee, batch code verification, and customer values.
- [The Atelier](https://riverafragrances.com/atelier): Olfactory guides, fragrance notes breakdown, longevity ratings, and layering techniques.
- [Fragrance Journal](https://riverafragrances.com/journal): Educational articles, clone guides, Middle Eastern fragrance reviews, and seasonal recommendations.

## Contact & Inquiries

- **Location**: Malabon, Metro Manila, Philippines
- **Fulfillment**: Metro Manila express dispatch & nationwide Philippine delivery
- **Customer Care**: Direct inquiries through the online store portal and social channels
